_formato: Library of transport data, per species and background gas (key ESPECIE em FUNDO, that is SPECIES in BACKGROUND, with ZDPlasKin names in upper case).
The fields are those of the transporte.json of a case (mobilidade, difusao, perda_na_parede, atomos_do_fundo, fonte); the mass comes from the formula.
ferramentas/caso.py transport copies from here into the transporte.json of the case whatever is missing there.

AR em AR.fonte: diffusion: the same value as Ar*, as in the Fortran code (DK); used only with --free-gas

AR* em AR.fonte: diffusion of the Fortran code (DK in termico.f90), no primary source recorded; loss of every metastable that reaches the wall, as in the Fortran code

AR^+ em AR.fonte: Golyatina e Maiorov, Plasma Phys. Rep. 43, 75 (2017), a 300 K; Ellis et al. 1976 medem K0 = 1,53

AR2^+ em AR.fonte: Phys. Rev. 160, 130 (1967), authors not recorded in the project; no high-field data

N^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N2^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 203, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N3^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 7%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N4^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204-205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; measured only up to 40 Td (N4+ dissociates above); above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N2(A) em N2.fonte: diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(B) em N2.fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(A') em N2.fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(C) em N2.fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: 0.202 cm2/s at 760 Torr and 300 K (Planet. Space Sci., 1967, doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4); exponent 1.75 assumed; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N em N2.fonte: estimated diffusion: measured self-diffusion of N2 (0.202 cm2/s, 1 atm, 300 K) scaled by the reduced mass and by the hard-sphere diameter of N (2.75 Å at 280 K, Diffusion coefficients of O and N atoms in inert gases) against 3.75 Å for N2; loss: recombination at the quartz wall, gamma = 2.16e-6 (Mazánková, Trunec and Krčma, 2015, afterglow at 1000 Pa)

N2 em N2.fonte: self-diffusion taken equal to the measured one of N2(A); used only with --free-gas

N2(V1) em N2+H2.fonte: diffusion by kinetic theory (Cantera 3.2, GRI-Mech 3.0 transport parameters), trace in N2:H2 1:1, 1/D = sum x_j/D_kj; exponent fitted from 300 to 1000 K (as N2); wall loss: Sun et al. 2022, supplement, Table S1 (from Hong et al. 2017); diffusion taken equal to that of N2
